Paragraph: "He who is a virtuous one and protector of all the world, and who is the only refuge for all in earlier times... such a Raaghava, my mentor, is now seeking refuge with Sugreeva...

Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Expresses reverence for Rama while framing the alliance as a mutual compact.
Outcome/Resolution: Reinforces the gravity of the proposed friendship.
